subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult male Rover in <Picture 1>, providing his identity, facial features, hairstyle, costume, accessories, body proportions, and stylized game-character appearance.
<Subject 2> is the adult female character 清宵 in <Picture 2>, providing her identity, facial features, hairstyle, costume, accessories, body proportions, and stylized game-character appearance.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1).
<Audio 2> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 2> (S2).

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 15-second, 9:16 vertical romantic-comedy scene uses twelve shots to show <Subject 1> accepting a fourth invitation despite resolving to refuse. <Subject 2> approaches him on a lantern-lit bridge. Her confident request becomes quietly personal, weakening his resolve. <Audio 1> guides his voice timbre, and <Audio 2> guides hers. New Mandarin dialogue follows the written scene.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 6], [Shot 7], [Shot 9], [Shot 10], [Shot 11], [Shot 12]): fully_preserved - preserve his referenced identity, appearance, costume, accessories, proportions, and stylized rendering.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 5], [Shot 6], [Shot 8], [Shot 10], [Shot 11]): fully_preserved - preserve her referenced identity, appearance, costume, accessories, proportions, and stylized rendering.
<Audio 1>: reference - use its speaker timbre for the male character's newly generated dialogue. Do not copy its original words, background sounds, or soundtrack.
<Audio 2>: reference - use its speaker timbre for the female character's newly generated dialogue. Do not copy its original words, background sounds, or soundtrack.

detailed_description:
Japanese game-style 3D cel-shaded animation, with sculpted hair, clean facial shadow shapes, and crisp costume details. Warm bridge lanterns illuminate faces against a cool dusk background. Vertical framing emphasizes expressions and hand movements. Maintain consistent eyelines and connect detail inserts through continuous action. Generate synchronized Mandarin speech using the assigned voice references. No subtitles or visible writing.

[Shot 1] A tight detail shot follows <Subject 1>'s hand pushing a silver-purple card into the pocket holding a pale-blue coffee card and a coral ticket. The edges catch. He impatiently presses them down; paper and fabric rustle.

[Shot 2] At 00:00.700, cut to his face as he walks. His brows tighten and his lips briefly compress. Using the voice timbre from <Audio 1>, <Subject 1> (S1) mutters with restrained frustration, <d>[Chinese] 不再答应了.</d> He lifts his chin, trying to regain resolve.

[Shot 3] At 00:01.900, cut tightly to his eyes. He notices someone ahead. His eyelids lift slightly, and his determined gaze becomes apprehensive.

[Shot 4] At 00:02.400, cut to his boots. His leading foot stops and settles on the bridge stones. The final footstep is distinct.

[Shot 5] At 00:02.800, cut to <Subject 2> in medium close-up, his shoulder at the left foreground. She offers a pale green-and-white card at chest height. Using the voice timbre from <Audio 2>, <Subject 2> (S2) says with composed confidence, <d>[Chinese] 明天一点, 陪我逛街.</d> Her chin rises slightly; her eyes remain on him.

[Shot 6] At 00:05.100, cut to their hands. His fingers approach the offered card, stop just short, then withdraw toward his crowded pocket. Her hand remains steady.

[Shot 7] At 00:05.600, cut to his face. He forces a small polite smile, then meets her eyes. Using <Audio 1>'s timbre, <Subject 1> (S1) says with hesitant firmness, <d>[Chinese] 我有安排了.</d> His smile fades as he waits for her response.

[Shot 8] At 00:07.100, cut to her face. Her chin lowers and her confident smile softens into expectation. Using <Audio 2>'s timbre, <Subject 2> (S2) asks quietly but directly, <d>[Chinese] 一个小时也不肯?</d> A slight camera push emphasizes her waiting gaze.

[Shot 9] At 00:09.100, cut tightly to his face. His eyes shift aside. His lips part for another refusal, then close. A small nasal exhale accompanies his brows relaxing. He looks back at her, visibly yielding.

[Shot 10] At 00:10.200, cut to the card transfer. He takes its edge; she releases it after his grip is secure. Using <Audio 1>'s timbre, <Subject 1> (S1), off-screen, answers softly, <d>[Chinese] 好.</d> A faint paper rustle follows.

[Shot 11] At 00:10.900, cut to her face. One corner of her mouth lifts with satisfaction. Using <Audio 2>'s timbre, <Subject 2> (S2) says crisply, <d>[Chinese] 不许迟到.</d> She turns and passes him, her shoulder creating a brief foreground wipe that reveals his polite smile behind her.

[Shot 12] At 00:12.300, cut to his face in the revealed position. His eyes follow her, then lower toward the fourth card at the frame's bottom. His smile slowly collapses; his inner brows draw together and his shoulders sink. He presses two fingers against his brow and briefly closes his eyes. Hold his quiet regret and defeated exhale through the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Soft flowing water, evening breeze, distant footsteps, paper rustles, and clothing movement create a quiet physical soundscape. Keep ambience low beneath the newly generated dialogue, with audible pauses and natural breaths.
